title: 버터 페이퍼
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable 1024 by 1024 square seamless material tile for a football management game's controller background design proposal P1.
Primary request: Butter cream uncoated matchday programme paper, warm ivory and pale straw, soft visible irregular cellulose fibres and very few tiny ochre flecks. Fine letterpress-paper tooth, no folds. The most neutral and quiet option.
Composition: edge-to-edge uniform material, perfectly orthographic flat overhead macro, same tone and texture density at all four edges, seamless repeat, no vignette, no gradient or directional lighting, no obvious repeating geometric motif. Main colour approximately #eadbb8.
Constraints: texture stays subtle enough for small live interface text laid on top. Material alone, no screen mockup, no buttons, no icons, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no frame, no border, no watermark.
